originality.rationale: The source paper covers the strict-fast parameter regime only. Fang (2025/2026) already proves a logarithmic-clock Brownian process for a deterministic-total critical elephant random walk, so clock, topology and Brownian structure are not novel generally. value.rationale: The critical marginal normal law cannot determine multi-epoch correlations. The theorem identifies an entire Brownian motion in logarithmic observation time, with exact covariance q min(s,t) and independent increments, despite a random total count. The equality surface is a natural phase transition separating the fast Gaussian and reinforcement-dominated regimes.
